subject: Re: Journey dialogue kickoff — participant confirmation & recording release
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@blueoakhealth.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@blueoakhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Intro + interest in doing a customer journey piece

Hi Ava / Marissa —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. BlueOak had a great experience rolling Redwood into our analytics pipeline and our comms team asked whether we'd be willing to do a short piece on the implementation journey and business impact. We're happy to participate if the ask is light — a 30–45 minute discussion, a follow-up quote, and a short recording release for use in a case study page.

Priya (cc) will coordinate logistics on our side. At minimum we'll include one engineering lead and one product manager as interviewees. Can you share a brief agenda and any release/consent language you need?

Best,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Partnerships — BlueOak Health
attachments: none
From: Ava Chen <ava@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@blueoakhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@blueoakhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + interest in doing a customer journey piece

Liam —

Huge thanks — we'd love to feature BlueOak. Suggested plan below and a couple of quick asks.

Proposed session (30–40 minutes):
- 5 min quick intros and goals
- 20–25 min discovery: what problem you were solving, why Redwood, implementation timeline, and key win metrics
- 5–10 min impact & quote capture + any follow-up questions

Logistics / asks:
- Who will join from BlueOak (names + titles)?
- Can you confirm a 30–40 minute slot next week? We have openings: Mon 12/14 10:00–11:00 PT, Tue 12/15 14:00–15:00 PT, Wed 12/16 08:30–09:30 PT.
- We record the session (audio + video) for drafting the case study. I've attached a short recording release and a one-page agenda. If you have legal concerns, we can redline the release.

Attachments: boh_kickoff_agenda_v1.pdf; redwood_recording_release.docx

Marissa and Aditya will run the session; Neha will help coordinate the follow-up quote form. If any of those should be swapped out, let me know.

Best regards,
Ava Chen
Senior Customer Marketing Manager — Redwood Inference
mobile: +1 (415) 555-0142
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@blueoakhealth.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@blueoakhealth.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 11:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + interest in doing a customer journey piece

Liam —

Quick note on agenda and suggested prep so we maximize the 30–40 minutes:
- Please have the engineering lead prepared to talk about architecture decisions (how you routed requests, any quantization/throughput tradeoffs, and the rollout cadence).
- Product manager: top three customer-facing metrics improved since deployment (e.g., query latency, cost per inference, or error rates).
- If there are any non-disclosure constraints (vendor names, exact dollar figures), flag them up front and we'll avoid publishing those details.

Also attaching a simple quote capture template we'll use after the session — nothing binding, just to get an attributable soundbite.

On our side, proposed facilitator: Marissa Cole. Recording release is straightforward; the key permission is to use the recording and one pull-quote in marketing materials. If BlueOak needs a pre-publication review window, we can offer a 7-business-day review before final publishing.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Field Marketing — Redwood Inference
attachments: quote_capture_template.docx

Hi Ava / team —

Thanks, all. Confirming the Tue 12/15 14:00–14:40 PT slot works for our group. Participants:
- Liam O'Connor — Head of Partnerships
- Priya Singh — Program Manager (will be primary coordinator)
- Eric Morales — Lead Backend Engineer
- Sara Velasquez — Senior Product Manager
